about: Log 404 held-out set, written 2026-10-11 before any run of it. Gold verdicts follow capability_sheet.yaml. Families: QN unsupported result asked as a question about how a method works; QP the same form for supported results; K a second turn that only adds a constraint or correction (sent with --resume); M questions about methods themselves (MN names a registered workflow, MC names none); B two results of one workflow, the second a less obvious output; P one supported and one unsupported result. M items have no requirement; they are labelled with `consult`.

items.prompt: We profiled liver expression every 3 hours across two days, with TF motifs and PPI. Is there a method that models how each TF's influence on a target at one time point carries over to the next time point?

requirements.words: models how each TF's influence on a target at one time point carries over to the next time point

items.prompt: We have a bipartite TF-gene network from PANDA. Is there a method that lets a TF belong to more than one module at the same time?

requirements.words: lets a TF belong to more than one module at the same time

requirements.words: whether the TF activates or represses that gene in each individual tumor
